facts.fact: Loi n°001/2011 on personal data protection, promulgated at Libreville on 25 September 2011, is gazetted in JO n°74 of 24-31 October 2011 and sets the rules for processing personal data.
facts.system: Loi n°001/2011 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The law creates the CNPDCP as an independent administrative authority with nine permanent commissioners appointed by decree, and gives it sanction powers, with appeal to the Conseil d'Etat (Arts. 15-17, 108).
The law states that implementing texts, taken after the Commission's opinion, will fix its application procedures (Art. 112); none is issued in the text itself.
